changelog:
Initial release of handdraw-flowchart.

- Generates hand-drawn style workflow diagrams from natural-language process descriptions.
- Converts strictly validated Mermaid (flowchart, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram) into Excalidraw scenes and exports PNG images.
- Script ensures Mermaid syntax validity and supports rejection of unsupported diagram types.
- Supports editable diagrams with best quality for flowcharts; sequence and class diagrams are supported with caveats.
- Provides stepwise workflow and strict validation rules for consistent and reliable outputs.
